## Validation

CI runs automatically on every pull request. Locally:

- [ ] `bun run check` (typecheck, unit tests, build, docs, package checks)
- [ ] `bun run test:browser` (benchmark smoke, visual, interaction, website; needs Chrome) — for rendering, plugin, or website changes
- [ ] `bun run docs:readme` if public APIs changed (regenerates the API reference)
